value.rationale: The triangular prism is one of precisely two connected six-vertex cubic simple graphs; the already-known other graph K3,3 has no second homology. This provides a natural complete small-graph integral comparison and shows the multipath functor distinguishes equal-order, equal-degree cubic graphs. Specific ranks and all-torsion exclusions for 18-arc prism are non-implied by family theorems; no general theorem is claimed.
